description: This file defines a Rectangle class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing geometric operations such as combining rectangles, intersection, overlap detection, and containment checks.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: A class representing a rectangle with integer coordinates and dimensions, supporting operations like equality, inequality, combining, intersection, overlap detection, and containment.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are equal based on their x, y, w, h values.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are not equal.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Expands the rectangle to include another rectangle, forming the minimal bounding rectangle.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two rectangles as a new rectangle.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Returns the minimal bounding rectangle that contains both rectangles.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a point (tx, ty) is inside the rectangle.
